question: Should `plugin.approval.resolved` become a public nullable-decision cleanup event, and must every abort-aware plugin approval requester use `plugin.approval.cancel` before this PR can merge?
rationale: The code fix is plausible, but adding a gateway method and changing the exported resolved-event shape is a public contract decision that normal tests cannot settle.

options.title: Complete one cancel contract
options.body: Require this PR to wire cancellation through every abort-aware plugin approval waiter and align docs/SDK tests around nullable cleanup events before merge.

options.title: Accept the narrow fix
options.body: Allow only the `before_tool_call` path to land now, while leaving the linked issue or a follow-up open for sibling waiters and contract documentation.

options.title: Pause the public API change
options.body: Hold this branch until maintainers decide whether cancellation should use nullable resolved events or a different protocol shape.

recommendation.title: Complete one cancel contract
recommendation.body: Require this PR to wire cancellation through every abort-aware plugin approval waiter and align docs/SDK tests around nullable cleanup events before merge.
